---
# Rendered once while building the Docker image (see Dockerfile), as the user that runs the app.
# It uses the same PDF settings and LaTeX features as `app/reports/report-external.qmd`, so that
# Quarto installs all the LaTeX packages they need into TinyTeX at build time. The app then never
# has to download LaTeX packages at runtime on SciLifeLab Serve.
# Keep the format options in sync with `report-external.qmd`.
title: "LaTeX smoke test"
format:
  pdf:
    echo: false
    fig-align: center
    documentclass: report
    classoption: landscape
    papersize: a4
    geometry:
      - margin=20mm
      - heightrounded
    mainfont: Lato
toc: true
number-sections: true
---

# Text and math

A feature was kept if its maximum peak area was $> 5 \times$ the average blank peak area.

# Tables

```{r}
# Like show$kable_number_of() and the "Summary of Targets" table of the external report
df <- data.frame(Class = c("Kid", "Mom", "QC"), Number = c(214L, 209L, 25L), Percent = c("47.8%", "46.7%", "5.6%"))
knitr::kable(df, caption = "Samples", align = "lrr") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
knitr::kable(df, caption = "Summary of Targets") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE, repeat_header_continued = TRUE)
```

# Figures

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df, aes(Class, Number)) + geom_col()
```
